description: Create a captcha challenge for a form: a proof of work (find a whole number nonce from 0 to 9007199254740991 so that SHA-256 of the salt followed by the nonce in decimal starts with bits zero bits) and a click task in a PNG of shapes, digits and letters. level normal, the default, asks for 18 bits and three symbols the question names; hard for 19 bits and four symbols by a rule (the digits and the letters each in an order); harder for 20 bits and five of nine symbols by a rule that also picks; hardest for the same work and task on a picture that comes turned by steps of turn_step degrees, which the person turns upright before clicking. The answer has the id, level, salt, bits, expires_at (30 minutes), the question, count (points to click) and the verify links, and the picture as an image of the result. The challenge keeps no address. Each address may make 500 challenges a day, a Pro plan more. Check it once with verify_captcha from the server that receives the form. No API key, no account and no sign up.

level.description: Optional: normal (the default), hard, harder or hardest.

name: create_captcha
title: Create a captcha challenge
